The '''Hysalria system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hysalrian/Legends|Hysalrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Galaxy9" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hysalria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The Online Companion placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
